name: Limited Jumps Obby
desc:
Welcome to LIMITED JUMPS OBBY! This game is like any normal difficulty chart obby… except you only get a limited number of jumps per stage! Only the most precise players can make it through! Can you beat the game without running out of jumps or rage quitting?

Inspired by IMPOSSIBLE OBBY & Limited Jumps! 🎉

- 🔢 100 unique, colorful, and fun stages!
- 🌟 Collect rebirth points to buy halos for your avatar!
- 📈 Rebirth to climb the leaderboards and compete against others!

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shiftlock (Shift, LT)

scripts.title: Free Rebirth
scripts.script:
local function teleportThroughCheckpoints()
    local index = 1
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

    local function teleportToCheckpoint(index)
        local checkpoint = workspace.Checkpoints:FindFirstChild(tostring(index))
        
        if checkpoint then
            player.Character:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(checkpoint.CFrame)
            if index == 101 then
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Rebirth"):FireServer()
                return false
            end
            
            return true
        else
            return false
        end
    end

    while true do
        local continue = teleportToCheckpoint(index)
        
        if not continue then
            break
        end
        
        index = index + 1
        
        wait(0.2)
    end
end

while true do
    teleportThroughCheckpoints()
    wait(2)
end
